mapper.select: SELECT LOCKED_UNTIL FROM LOGIN_ATTEMPT WHERE ACCOUNT_KEY = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOGIN_ATTEMPT (ACCOUNT_KEY, FAILURE_COUNT, WINDOW_STARTED_AT, LOCKED_UNTIL, EXPIRES_AT) VALUES (#{key}, #{state.failureCount}, #{state.windowStartedAt}, #{state.lockedUntil,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{state.expiresAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LOGIN_ATTEMPT WHERE ACCOUNT_KEY IN ( SELECT ACCOUNT_KEY FROM LOGIN_ATTEMPT WHERE EXPIRES_AT <= #{now} AND ROWNUM <= 1000 )
